nodes.name: HTTP Request - LINE Push (Preventive Alert to Lead)

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets) AS total_tickets,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE created_at::date = current_date) AS today_tickets,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE date_trunc('month', created_at) = date_trunc('month', now())) AS month_tickets,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE status IN ('Open','Assigned','In Progress','Waiting for Parts','Waiting for User')) AS in_progress,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE status IN ('Completed','Closed')) AS closed_tickets,
  (SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - created_at))/3600) FROM tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS avg_repair_hours,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_logs WHERE resolved = true) AS resolved_by_chatbot,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_logs WHERE resolved = false) AS escalated_to_staff
SELECT intent, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbot_logs GROUP BY intent ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT device_id, device_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tickets GROUP BY device_id, device_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT organization, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tickets GROUP BY organization ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tickets WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY device_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
